units.text: EXT. ABANDONED SKATE PARK - NIGHT
Cracked concrete bowls.
A chain-link fence sags.
Sleet has started, thin and mean, and one flickering streetlight buzzes over the empty ramps.
MAYA, 16, short, braids, a thrifted puffer jacket two sizes too big, stands at the lip of the biggest bowl.
Her phone glows in her hand.
Screen reads: "grp chat: SURVIVORS (14)".
Only one other name is still green.
A shape climbs over the fence.
JALEN, 17, tall, a hoodie soaked black, a flashlight in his teeth.
He drops it into his palm.
Okay. So it's us. Everyone else left the chat.
units.name: JALEN

units.text: You're taller than your pfp.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: You're real. Like, actually real.
units.name: JALEN

units.text: Her phone BUZZES.
A new message from someone neither of them knows: "dont go home."
Did you send this?
units.name: MAYA

units.text: No. Maya, no. I only got the group link like an hour ago.
units.name: JALEN

units.text: The streetlight DIES.
Darkness takes the park, and the sleet sounds louder.
Somewhere past the fence a car door SLAMS.
Turn the flashlight off.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: I thought this would be, like, cute. A meetup.
units.name: JALEN

units.text: Yeah. Me too.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: The phone BUZZES again, brighter in the dark.
She covers it with her palm.
Do you trust me?
units.name: JALEN

units.text: I trust you more than the chat.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: Footsteps crunch on gravel, slow, getting closer.
